# CyberNet AI

> CyberNet AI is a scam checker. Paste a text, email or link, or upload a QR code or screenshot, and get a clear SCAM or LOW RISK verdict with the reasons in plain words. If you already clicked, paid or shared a code, Recovery builds a step-by-step plan.

- Website: https://cybernetai.app/ (3 free Quick Scans without an account; a free account adds more daily checks, Analysis AI explanations and Recovery)
- iPhone app: https://apps.apple.com/app/cybernet-ai/id6828596086 (free; not yet on EU App Stores)
- Quick Scan runs in the browser or on the iPhone. It shows warning signs; it is not antivirus software and cannot promise that something is safe.
- Checks cover English and Arabic scam messages, including Gulf (UAE) scams.

## Scam guides

- [Is this text a scam? Free scam text checker](https://cybernetai.app/scam-text-checker)
- [Parcel delivery scam texts](https://cybernetai.app/parcel-delivery-scam-text)
- [Fake toll and traffic fine texts (Salik, RTA, E-ZPass)](https://cybernetai.app/toll-fine-scam-text)
- [QR code scams](https://cybernetai.app/qr-code-scam)
- [Is this link safe?](https://cybernetai.app/is-this-link-safe)
- [Black Friday scam checklist](https://cybernetai.app/black-friday-scam-checklist)
